description: This file defines the EmployeeReportData class, which implements report data handling for employee time reports within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to normalize timesheet data and retrieve metadata related to employee timesheet summaries, utilizing various service traits and APIs.

classes.name: EmployeeReportData
classes.description: Implements report data functionality for employee time reports, including normalization of timesheet entries and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the report data object with search filter parameters.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Transforms timesheet items into a structured array suitable for reporting, formatting durations.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves additional metadata for the report, including total durations and employee information.
